task_name: One-line freshness banner with details on demand
description: The freshness banner (catalog.graph !== 'ready') is one line: the state as a short sentence ('Graph is stale.' / 'Graph is missing.' / 'Graph is unknown.'), a ghost 'Details' disclosure button with a chevron (aria-expanded, aria-controls) only when catalog.graphReason is set, and the unchanged 'Rebuild graph' control (same behaviour and 'Rebuilding…' label). Details opens the full reason as a paragraph below the line inside the same banner (flex-basis 100%, wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere); closed by default. Open state is stored as the reason text that was opened, so it is open only while catalog.graphReason equals it: a changed reason closes it. CSS keeps the first line on one row (state text ellipsizes, Details and Rebuild do not shrink).

assumptions: The state word is shown as the CLI reports it ('stale', 'missing', 'unknown') in 'Graph is <state>.', as before T16.

behavior_changes.description: Details is a ghost small button labelled 'Details' with a chevron (down when closed, up when open) placed between the state sentence and 'Rebuild graph'; the opened reason is plain small text on its own line under them, inside the banner.
alternatives: A text link 'Details' instead of a button
Show the reason as a tooltip on the state sentence

behavior_changes.description: Open/closed is explorer state keyed by the reason text: it survives leaving the tab and a catalog reload with the same reason, and closes when the reason changes.

The test 'wiki stays readable without a graph…' still passes unchanged: it asserts 'Graph is missing', which the new sentence 'Graph is missing.' contains.
